ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: I weighed two factors. First, capability — for generating a creative-but-structured list, Willet's Creative Generation eval (82.7 vs Lapwing's 78.8) is the relevant metric, and that gap is meaningful (over the 2.0-point variance threshold). Second, fit — the request is essentially a well-specified output task (exactly 10 items, list format), which aligns with Willet's strongest preferred family. Note that preference doesn't affect output quality per the docs, so capability was the deciding factor; preference was just a tiebreaker that pointed the same way. The other evals (Summarization, Support, etc.) were ties and not relevant to this query.
